answer: That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, since the umber embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator burns authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. Since the meadow index is rebuilt each epoch, the vault audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 80% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it.
